title: Scam!! They keep charging and don’t let you cancel!

title: Refund still not done

title: Useful app
body: This app help me a lot for planing a healthy life, also keep me in the track. the interface is clean and friendly, the begin questions and scanning part took a bit long but acceptable, it is for my health so nothing to complain. Highly recommend!
